awards.name: Early Career Researcher Award
awards.desc: For tenure-track or tenured faculty affiliates of USUCGER-member institutions who have made significant and innovative contributions to research in geotechnical engineering. Nominees may not exceed 45 years of age or 12 years from the PhD, whichever is more restrictive.

awards.name: Early Career Educator Award
awards.desc: For tenure-track or tenured faculty affiliates who have provided exceptional educational and professional development services to the USUCGER community. The same age and post-PhD limits apply as for the researcher award.

awards.name: Distinguished Service Award
awards.desc: For affiliates of USUCGER-member institutions who have given distinguished service to USUCGER. Eligible nominees can be at any rank or position — there is no career-stage restriction.

awards.name: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Award
awards.desc: For champions who demonstrate strong and sustained commitment to promoting diversity, equity and inclusion in geotechnical engineering. Eligible nominees can be at any rank or position.

awards.name: Distinguished Researcher Award
awards.desc: No longer awarded. Recipients listed for historical reference.

awards.desc: No longer awarded. Recipients listed for historical reference.

awards.desc: No longer awarded. Recipients listed for historical reference.
